scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others "cd frontend && yarn && PORT=4000 yarn dev" "cd backend && yarn dev"
scripts.release:patch: yarn config set version-tag-prefix '' && yarn version --patch && git push --tags
scripts.release:minor: yarn config set version-tag-prefix '' && yarn version --minor && git push --tags
scripts.release:major: yarn config set version-tag-prefix '' && yarn version --major && git push --tags
